_comment: ADR 0044, ADR 0090 — the collision layer names of the spec. Each entity's physics.collision_layer / collision_mask lists the layer NAMES it lives on and reacts to, or "all". The interpreter maps each name to a host bit. A raw number is an error. A new name is a change to this file.
_authoring_note: The numbers are the Godot interpreter's bit numbers (1..32), not part of the spec. physics.collision_layer: ["wall"] sets bit 2. collision_mask: "all" sets every bit.
